lines: Auto starts at Low, to stay smooth. Check this device finds out how much more this one can hold.
It rides a test world off screen, level by level from the top, about thirty seconds each, and shows what each level held.
It stops at the first level that holds the display's rate, says so, and keeps the result on this device. A fixed level stays as chosen.
Auto then starts there. A race opens at Medium, where this check found it smooth, instead of Low.
The check's result, from a phone to the full screen.
Stop the check, or hide the tab, and its renderer is let go: nothing more is drawn and nothing is kept.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
